## TryGetSlotClientRect

```typescript
TryGetSlotClientRect(index: number): RectangleF | null;
```

Requires feature: `PoE.Follow`.

Script projection of the belt-slot rectangle. The native `RectangleF` form remains for
Rust UI consumers; BindGen owns the structural JS encoding.

## Item

```typescript
Item(index: number): Poe2FlaskAccessor;
```

Read a zero-based belt slot, also available as Flasks[index]. Slots 0/1 are life/mana; 2–4 are charms.
Out-of-range indices throw. An empty or unavailable slot still provides its normal status handle.

**@keywords**

flasks, charms, belt, indexer, reagent

## Use

```typescript
Use(index: number): boolean;
```

Queue the default belt key D1–D5 for a zero-based slot through script-owned input.
Returns false for an invalid slot or unavailable input. True means queued, not recovery confirmed.
Rebound game keys are not resolved.

**@keywords**

flask, charm, input, queue, ownership
